## Batch 32 handoff

Authored the 12 assigned items, A/B pages, manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch notes, and Step 1 records. The pages now declare their required page dependencies. I also reordered proof steps to match their dependency layers and updated the contracts accordingly.

Five items are **ready**: the local definitions and lemmas, plus the mean and median replacement-breakdown theorem. Seven influence-dependent items are **escalated**: their batch 29 suppliers are present, but those suppliers inherit an unresolved requirement for the missing `local-asymptotic-normality-contiguity-and-efficiency` page. The batch 31 contamination page and `def-gross-error-path` are now verified and ready.

## Checks and remaining blocker

Strict proof contracts passed for 12/12 items; precheck passed all 8 proof-bearing items; proof-layout found 0 defects across 36 steps; rendercheck and focused depcheck reported 0 errors and warnings; source-fetch verification passed for all 4 sources. The five ready records’ hashes also validate.

The live run remains held at Step 1. It reports an owner-held repair for units 9, 11, 19, 35, and 27, and marks batch 32 artifact-incomplete because seven items are escalated. I left run state and blocker records unchanged.
